categories.main_business_segments: Senshu Electric Co., Ltd. and its group companies operate primarily in the sale of electric wires and cables, including machine cables, communication cables, power cables, general-purpose coated wires, and related electrical installation materials. The group also engages in the sale of information-related equipment. The business is managed as a single segment: the electric wire and cable business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company functions mainly as a trading company (wholesaler) with some in-house processing capabilities, such as cable assembly and terminal processing. It collaborates with manufacturers to develop original products and strengthens its processing division to meet user needs. Manufacturing and processing methods focus on quality assurance and just-in-time delivery systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Senshu Electric serves a broad range of industries, including construction, machinery and equipment, automotive, LCD and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, and general electrical contractors. The company does not rely on a single industry or customer, with no customer accounting for more than 10% of sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s main market is Japan, which accounts for over 90% of sales and assets. It also has a growing international presence with subsidiaries and operations in Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, China (Shanghai and Tianjin), Taiwan, and the United States (Michigan).
categories.supply_chain_position: Senshu Electric operates primarily as a midstream distributor and value-added wholesaler, positioned between manufacturers (upstream) and end-users or contractors (downstream). It also provides some downstream value through cable processing and assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing original products in collaboration with manufacturers, expanding the processing division, strengthening sales and logistics for just-in-time delivery, increasing sales of high-value-added FA cables for industrial machinery, and expanding non-cable product lines. The company is also focused on ESG initiatives, sustainability, and global expansion, but does not conduct significant proprietary R&D.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of electric wires, cables, and related materials, as well as information-related equipment. The company operates on a traditional distribution and wholesale model, with revenue recognized upon delivery or inspection of goods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Senshu Electric is one of Japan’s leading independent electric wire and cable trading companies, competing with other specialized distributors and trading firms. It differentiates itself through its technical expertise, original product development, and strong logistics network. Major competitors include other large electrical wholesalers and specialized cable distributors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending October 2024, consolidated net sales reached 136.2 billion yen, with operating profit of 10.3 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 7.6 billion yen. The company has demonstrated strong growth, achieving record sales and profits for three consecutive years, and aims to reach 160 billion yen in sales and 13 billion yen in ordinary profit by FY2027.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Senshu Electric emphasizes its ability to provide timely, high-quality, and customized cable solutions through its technical trading expertise, original product development, and robust logistics network. The company’s value proposition includes just-in-time delivery, a broad product lineup, responsiveness to diverse customer needs, and a commitment to sustainability and ESG practices.
